title: 第一卷 第18章 人人如龙，不朽仙族！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
“这枚天圣丹，我想将其赠予云溪！”

    “而这枚元圣丹，我想把它用在凝薇身上！”

    姜无痕开口，说出了自己的想法。

    一时间，祖地陷入了安静。

    方才，五位老祖与姜临天神念对接，知晓了最近这段时间发生的一些事情。

    “小无痕，能不能说说……为什么要做出这样的决定？”

    三祖问道。

    在他们看来，即便沐云溪嫁给了姜无痕，沐凝薇又是他的继女，但她们终究不是姜家的人。

    非我族类，其心必异！

    姜无痕并未直接回答，他先是屏退了姜凌尘和姜纤纤，这才开口道：“有系统在，只要能不断娶妻、生子，像天圣丹这样的东西，要多少有多少！”

    “如今的关键是，一些大势力将他们的天骄女修视若珍宝，绝不会轻易让她们嫁到姜家为妾。与其上门提亲屡遭拒绝，倒不如……让他们将天骄女修主动送来和亲！”

    此话一出，在场众人无不吃了一惊。

    “主送送来？”姜临天眉头紧锁，轻叹一声，“这话说起来容易，可这怎么可能！”

    “你忘了昨天在太凰仙朝，连一个小小的仙朝公主，对此事都嗤之以鼻，更别说那些大势力之中，真正的天骄了！”

    姜临天一直在张罗这件事，自然知晓其中的难度。

    “所以我说，将这次血脉升华的机会给云溪和凝薇，就是要各方势力看到，嫁入我姜家……并非是单纯的联姻，更是一场造化！”

    姜无痕轻笑，继续解释道：“云溪虽是太凰仙朝的长公主，但由于当年那桩谣言，导致她声誉尽毁，又被囚禁多年，受人冷眼。”

    “沐凝薇更是如此，虽然顶着个郡主的名头，却卑微的像是路边的野草，任谁都能来踩上一脚！”

    “若是让她们母女俩成为圣体，甚至……极限圣体，这样的反差，足以那些曾经藐视她们，欺凌她们的人眼红，甚至嫉妒！”

    “而那些大势力，又如何能抵挡血脉升华的诱惑？”

    说白了，这就是一个阳谋！

    树立典型，放出消息。

    成为圣体的机会就摆在眼前，想要抓住这个机会，就看谁更主动了！

    然而，姜临天闻言，却变了脸色。

    “无痕，你这是想把天圣丹的消息泄露出去？绝对不行！”姜临天神色凝重，制止道，“关于你的任何事情，都是姜家的最高机密。即便只是血脉升华，也足以让各方势力疯狂！”
content_en:
"I want to give this Heavenly Holy Pill to Yunxi!"

"And this Yuan Sheng Dan, I want to use it on Ning Wei!"

Jiang Wuhen opened his mouth and expressed his thoughts.

For a while, the ancestral land fell into silence.

Just now, the five ancestors connected with Jiang Lintian's spiritual thoughts and learned about some things that happened recently.

"Xiao Wuhen, can you tell me... why you made such a decision?"

Sanzu asked.

In their view, even though Mu Yunxi was married to Jiang Wuhen and Mu Ningwei was his stepdaughter, they were not from the Jiang family after all.

Those who are not of my race must have different minds!

Jiang Wuhen did not answer directly. He first rejected Jiang Lingchen and Jiang Xianxian, and then said: "With the system, as long as we can continue to marry wives and have children, there will be as many things as Tiansheng Dan as we want!"

"The key now is that some powerful forces regard their talented female cultivators as treasures and will never let them marry into the Jiang family as concubines. Instead of being repeatedly rejected when they come to propose marriage, it would be better... let them take the initiative to send the talented female cultivators to come and get married!"

As soon as these words came out, everyone present was shocked.

"Send it to me from the Lord?" Jiang Lintian frowned and sighed softly, "This is easy to say, but how is this possible!"

"You forgot that yesterday in the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, even a little princess of the Immortal Dynasty scorned this matter, let alone the real genius among the big forces!"

Jiang Lintian has been working on this matter and naturally knows how difficult it is.

"So I said that giving this opportunity to Yunxi and Ningwei to sublimate their bloodline is to let all the forces see that marrying into my Jiang family... is not just a simple marriage, but also a blessing!"

Jiang Wuhen chuckled and continued to explain: "Although Yunxi is the eldest princess of the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, her reputation was completely ruined due to the rumors back then, and she was imprisoned for many years and was looked down upon by others."

"Mu Ningwei is even more like this. Although she has the title of a princess, she is as humble as a weed on the roadside. Anyone can step on her!"

"If mother and daughter are allowed to become Holy Body, or even...Ultimate Holy Body, such a contrast will make those who once despised them and bullied them jealous, even jealous!"

"And how can those big forces resist the temptation of bloodline sublimation?"

To put it bluntly, this is a conspiracy!

Set an example and spread the word.

The opportunity to become a Holy Eucharist is right in front of you. If you want to seize this opportunity, it depends on who is more proactive!

However, when Jiang Lintian heard this, his expression changed.

"Wuhen, do you want to leak the news about the Holy Pill? Absolutely not!" Jiang Lintian stopped him with a solemn expression, "Anything about you is the top secret of the Jiang family. Even just the sublimation of your bloodline is enough to drive all the forces crazy!"
